title: Sidecar claims census and cross-team action stub - weekend surge
content:
Quick snapshot: ad-hoc spreadsheet used to capture 'sidecar' (non-primary runtime) claims that could be used as fallback during the weekend surge window. This is intentionally lightweight: one row per claim, quick owner, estimate, and whether a hotfix is possible before next business day.

Sheet columns (first row): ClaimID | System | Owner | BU/Team | Impact (users/min) | SLA risk (Low/Med/High) | Blocking dependency | Quick mitigation (Y/N) | Est hours to fix | Status | Notes / next step

Rows:
S-001 | sidecar-cache | Samir Shah | infra-platform | 120 | High | Cache eviction races (PR #462) | Y | 3h | triaged | Deploy hotfix branch (infra PR 462) during low-traffic window; Samir to coordinate with SRE
S-002 | sidecar-auth-proxy | Maya Chen | security | 30 | Med | Token refresh race under load | N | 8h | investigating | Maya to reproduce locally and submit minimal failing test; possible canary route change
S-003 | sidecar-embed-store | Victor Alvarez | serving-runtime | 15 | Low | Dependent on DB replica lag | Y | 2h | mitigation-applied | Switched reads to nearest replica, monitoring for consistency; Victor to confirm 4h
S-004 | sidecar-routing | Priya Nambiar | platform-engineering | 450 | High | Mis-routed large-batch requests causing overload | N | 12h | open | Temporary rate-limit rule proposed; needs cross-team approval (product + SRE)
S-005 | sidecar-telemetry | Elena Rodriguez | observability | 0 | Low | Missing metric emits for sidecar cold-starts | Y | 1.5h | done | Added synthetic metric; dashboard tile created (dashboard id in linked artifacts)

Metrics snippet (live rough numbers):
- Total sidecar claims captured: 5
- Combined potential user impact (users/min): ~615
- High SLA risk claims: 2
- Claims with quick mitigation available: 3

Open items / who to ping:
- S-004 rate-limit proposal: need product sign-off (cc: Andrea P.); action: Priya to ping product on thread in #product-platform by 2027-11-03 10:00 PT
- S-002 failing test: Maya to open JIRA OPS-893 with reproducer and tag eng-auth squad; escalate if no progress by EOD 2027-11-04
- S-001 deploy coordination: Samir to schedule deploy in blackout window (2027-11-06 02:00-04:00 UTC) and post runbook in the incident channel

Decisions so far:
- Prefer hotfix deploys for low-risk quick mitigations (Est hours <= 3) if SRE approves.
- For high-impact routing issues, prefer temporary throttles + controlled rollout rather than immediate global deploy.

Quick action checklist (one-liners):
- [Samir] Prepare hotfix branch and smoke test for S-001 (target: 3h)
- [Maya] Create reproducer and JIRA for S-002 (target: EOD 11/04)
- [Victor] Monitor embed-store replica lag and confirm no data loss after switch (target: 4h)
- [Priya] Draft short note for product + SRE about proposed rate-limiter and expected user impact (target: 11/03 10:00 PT)
- [Elena] Confirm telemetry dashboard tile and share link in this sheet (done)

Notes to self / ad-hoc observations:
- This sheet intentionally avoids long remediation plans; it's a triage-first list so owners can grab what they can handle quickly.
- Keep 'Est hours to fix' conservative; we bias to under-promise for weekend ops.
- If any claim moves to 'open' > 24h, bump to weekly cross-team review.

Questions needing follow-up:
- Should sidecar routing have an automated emergency throttle that product can flip? (Cost/UX tradeoff)
- For claims that are 'N' quick mitigation but <12h work, consider rotating owner to oncall for hands-on pairing; are teams OK with that?

Changelog (short):
- 2027-11-02: initial capture by Elena during pre-weekend scrub
- 2027-11-03: Samir added S-001 details; Victor added mitigation note for S-003
- 2027-11-05: Elena added metrics snippet and final checklist; marked telemetry tile as done

Slack threads / refs (quick):
- #ops-sidecar (started 11/02)
- #platform-product (for rate-limit ask)

If you're reading this and own an item: add a timestamped comment in the sheet cell and update Status to one of: triaged / investigating / mitigation-applied / done / open.

-- end of sheet snapshot --
